title: 过零丁洋
author: 文天祥
intro: Written by a captured Song commander when his enemies demanded he urge his own side to surrender. His answer was this poem — ending in two lines every Chinese student knows: “Who in all history has not died? Let my loyal heart shine in the records.”
analysis: 1279年，文天祥被元军俘虏后，被押在船上经过广东的零丁洋。元军将领要他写信劝宋朝最后的将领投降，他就写了这首诗作为回答。首联回顾自己的一生：靠精通儒家经典考中状元做官，起兵抗元已经四年。颔联写国家和个人：山河破碎，像风里飘散的柳絮；自己的命运起起落落，像雨打的浮萍。这两句用比喻，把国破家亡写得很形象。颈联巧用地名：前两年在江西惶恐滩打了败仗，心里惶恐；如今在零丁洋上，只能感叹自己孤苦零丁。地名和心情正好重合，这叫“双关”。尾联是千古名句：自古以来谁能不死？我要留下一颗赤诚的心，照耀在史册上。“汗青”指史书（古人在竹简上写字前要先烤出竹子的水分）。前六句越写越悲，最后两句却一下子变得坚定昂扬，表明宁死不降的决心。
analysisEn: In 1279 Wen Tianxiang, a captured Song commander, was taken by ship across the Lingding Sea at the mouth of the Pearl River. The Yuan general ordered him to write to the last Song admiral urging surrender; this poem was his reply. The first couplet looks back on his life: he rose through mastering a Confucian classic and coming first in the imperial exam, and for four years now he has been fighting the Yuan. The second couplet sets the country beside himself: the land is shattered like willow fluff scattered by the wind; his own life rises and sinks like duckweed beaten by rain. The third couplet plays with place names. Two years earlier he was defeated at Huangkong (“Fear”) Rapids in Jiangxi, and he says he spoke of fear there; now, on the Lingding (“Alone”) Sea, he sighs at how alone he is. Place and feeling match exactly — a double meaning. Then the famous ending: since ancient times, who has not died? Let me leave a loyal, red heart to shine in the history books. 汗青, literally “sweated green”, means history, because bamboo strips were heated until they “sweated” before people wrote on them. Six lines of grief turn into two of iron resolve: he would rather die than surrender.
background: Wen Tianxiang (1236–1283) came first in the imperial exam of 1256 and later raised troops to resist the Mongol Yuan invasion. Captured in 1278, he refused every offer to serve the Yuan and was executed in Dadu (Beijing) after more than three years in prison; he is remembered as a model of loyalty.
pronunciation: 零丁 líng dīng；干戈 gān gē（“干”是盾牌，读 gān）；寥落 liáo luò；四周星 sì zhōu xīng；飘絮 piāo xù；浮沉 fú chén；萍 píng；惶恐滩 huáng kǒng tān；汗青 hàn qīng。
version: 采用统编初中语文教材文本。“干戈寥落四周星”有的版本作“干戈落落四周星”；“身世浮沉雨打萍”有的版本作“身世飘摇雨打萍”。

lines.py: xīn kǔ zāo féng qǐ yī jīng
lines.lit: Through hardship I met my fortune, rising through one classic;
lines.en: Through hard years, I rose by mastering a classic;

lines.py: gān gē liáo luò sì zhōu xīng
lines.lit: shields and spears grown sparse, four turns of the stars.
lines.en: four years of war now, and my army dwindling.

lines.py: shān hé pò suì fēng piāo xù
lines.lit: Mountains and rivers shattered, wind scattering willow fluff;
lines.en: The land lies broken, like willow fluff blown by the wind;

lines.py: shēn shì fú chén yǔ dǎ píng
lines.lit: my life floating and sinking, rain beating duckweed.
lines.en: my life rises and sinks, like duckweed beaten by rain.

lines.py: huáng kǒng tān tóu shuō huáng kǒng
lines.lit: At Fear Rapids I spoke of fear;
lines.en: At Fear Rapids I spoke of my fear;

lines.py: líng dīng yáng lǐ tàn líng dīng
lines.lit: on the Lonely Sea I sigh at being alone.
lines.en: on the Lonely Sea I sigh that I am alone.

lines.py: rén shēng zì gǔ shuí wú sǐ
lines.lit: In human life, since ancient times, who has not died?
lines.en: Since time began, who has ever escaped death?

lines.py: liú qǔ dān xīn zhào hàn qīng
lines.lit: I will leave a red heart to shine on the history books.
lines.en: Let me leave a loyal heart to shine in history.

words.en: the Lingding Sea, at the mouth of the Pearl River
words.note: 今写“伶仃洋”，在广东珠江口。

words.en: to meet with (fortune); to be chosen
words.note: 这里指遇到朝廷选拔。现代汉语“遭逢”多指遇到不幸。

words.en: to rise through mastering a classic
words.note: 指靠精通儒家经典考中科举。
现代汉语“大动干戈”“化干戈为玉帛”。
现代汉语书面语，指稀少、冷落。

words.en: four years (four cycles of the stars)

words.note: 今天仍常用来形容国家分裂、被侵略。

words.en: to float and sink — ups and downs
words.note: 现代汉语“宦海浮沉”“与世浮沉”。

words.en: duckweed, a tiny floating water plant

words.note: 现代汉语书面语，如“诚惶诚恐”。
古人写字前把竹简烤出水分（像出汗），后来代指史书。

imagery.name: 柳
imagery.zh: 风中飘散的柳絮比喻国家山河破碎、四分五裂。
imagery.en: Willow fluff scattered by the wind: the country broken into pieces.

imagery.name: 萍
imagery.zh: 雨打的浮萍比喻自己命运漂泊、身不由己。
imagery.en: Duckweed beaten by rain: his own life tossed about, out of his control.

imagery.name: 丹心
imagery.zh: 一颗红心代表对国家的忠诚，是全诗最后的回答。
imagery.en: A red heart stands for loyalty to the country — his final answer to his captors.
